properties.displayName: [Baseline] Network interfaces should not have public IP addresses
properties.description: Denies network interfaces that attach a public IP address to any of their IP configurations. Workloads should be reached through a load balancer, Application Gateway, Front Door, or Bastion rather than per-VM public IPs, which bypass centralized ingress controls and are a common lateral-entry point.

metadata.description: The effect the policy applies when a network interface has a public IP address attached.
